title: Restricted Standard WOFOST One-Day Structural State Integrator Qualification Evidence

qualified_production_capability.name: restricted one-day standard-WOFOST structural state integrator
prepare_phase: deep-copy caller owner into a candidate
derive running minimum temperature from candidate-local history
finalize_phase: derive B1.10 RELTR from explicit accepted IQROT/IPTRA window values
require supplied event-local rate packet to bind to that RELTR
apply leaf stress death from oldest cohorts
insert exactly one new youngest cohort and physiologically age survivors once
update LAIEXP and capture/use B1.10 post-threshold carryover semantics
apply first anthesis crossing correction so DVS lands exactly on 1

source_bound_semantic_mapping.legacy_fixed_cadence: B1.10 WOFOST DELT=1 and one task-3 crop update at day end
source_bound_semantic_mapping.anthesis: first DVS+dvr crossing of 1 sets anthesis flag and truncates dvr to 1-DVS
source_bound_semantic_mapping.leaf_death: water/high-LAI stress death is removed from oldest cohorts before lifespan death
source_bound_semantic_mapping.leaf_shift: one call shifts retained cohorts, ages them by FYSDEL*DELT and inserts one youngest cohort even when GRLV is zero
source_bound_semantic_mapping.LAIEXP: when pre-event LAIEXP<6 GLAIEXP is current-event input; after threshold the B1.10 saved value remains a continuation dependency
source_bound_semantic_mapping.day_start_climate_memory: nofd increments to at most seven, atmin7 shifts and current TMN enters the youngest slot

fail_closed_evidence: non-one-day active crop event is rejected
rate packet RELTR inconsistent with accepted aggregates is rejected
post-LAIEXP-threshold exact-reference path without carryover sidecar is rejected

explicit_qualification_boundary.reason: F-WOF26 integrates an explicit event-local rate packet but does not calculate the WOFOST rates themselves.
missing_rate_physics: organ growth and death rate calculation
explicit_qualification_boundary.accepted_aggregate_precondition: caller/runtime must provide frozen accepted-window IQROT/IPTRA values under F-KT/F-WOF25 lineage and exactly-once semantics; the value-only DTO cannot prove lineage itself

next_dependency: source-bound one-day standard-WOFOST rate evaluator capable of producing the qualified event-local rate packet without introducing persistent rate workspace or hidden calendar/global dependencies
